registers.basis: When this artifact enters, exile all artifacts and creatures with mana value 2 or less until this artifact leaves the battlefield.

deferred.claim: Activate to put all cards exiled with this artifact into their owners' graveyards, create one 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token per card put into a graveyard this way, then sacrifice this artifact.
deferred.basis: {6}{W}{W}: Put each card exiled with this artifact into its owner's graveyard, then create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token for each card put into a graveyard this way. Sacrifice this artifact.
